scripts.dev: yarn build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,frontend,backend "yarn workspace @whoami/shared dev" "yarn dev:frontend" "yarn dev:backend"
scripts.build: yarn build:shared && yarn workspace @whoami/backend build && yarn workspace @whoami/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:shared && yarn workspace @whoami/backend typecheck && yarn workspace @whoami/frontend typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: yarn build:shared && yarn workspace @whoami/backend build && vitest run
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build
